name: Little Boy Plus
rootCause: On June 17, 2026, Little Boy Plus — a fully decentralized DeFi mining protocol on BSC claiming “no team, no admin keys” — was exploited. An attacker exploited a logic vulnerability in the LBPHashrate contract’s _update() function. By triggering it with a zero-value transferFrom call (bypassing OpenZeppelin authorization), the attacker unauthorizedly called _harvest and minted LBP tokens directly to the PancakeSwap LBP/USDT pair via mintReward. This inflated the pair’s balance without updating reserves, allowing the attacker to drain ~377,642 USDT (~$367k–$378k) through PancakePair.swap(). The funds were later sent to Tornado Cash.

On June 18, 2026, Little Boy Plus was exploited on BNB Chain via an unauthorized minting bug. A zero-value transferFrom call bypassed allowance checks in the LBPHashrate contract, enabling the attacker to mint tokens directly into the PancakeSwap pair and desynchronize AMM reserves. The attacker drained approximately $377,642 USDT (about 610.5 BNB) through a single flash-loan-fueled swap, with no reported recovery or official mitigation published. Evidence is limited to technical monitoring and incident summaries; no direct block explorer transactions or full contract source are published.
